annotations.title: Query Court Real Estate Foreclosure Auctions

cleanProvenanceBadge: 100% First-Party & Open Government Licensed (commercial_resell_ok — Zero ToS-violating portal scraping)
description: Read-only, idempotent query of Supreme Court BIT foreclosure results and auction notices in 47 prefectures (API key or x402; daily). Pass stage, prefecture, or valuation bounds (default stage="all", limit=50, offset=0); returns auction records ordered by opening date descending. Note: For hazards, use query_seismic_hazards instead.

caseNumber.description: Court auction case number filter (e.g. "令和8年(ケ)").

court.description: District court name filter (e.g. "東京地方裁判所", "大阪地方裁判所").

limit.description: Maximum auction records to return (1 to 200).

maxValuationYen.description: Maximum court appraisal valuation in JPY (0 to 1,000,000,000,000).

minValuationYen.description: Minimum court appraisal valuation in JPY (0 to 1,000,000,000,000).

municipality.description: Municipality or ward substring filter (e.g. "千代田区", "札幌市").

offset.description: Zero-based pagination offset (0..10000, default 0). Combine with limit to page through large result sets deterministically.

prefecture.description: Nationwide Japanese prefecture filter across all 47 prefectures (e.g. "北海道", "東京都", "大阪府", "福岡県").

propertyKind.description: Real estate property type ("all", "土地", "戸建", "区分所有", or "一棟").

stage.description: Auction stage filter: "opening_results" (winning bids & multiples), "period_announcements" (upcoming auctions), or "all".

name: query_court_foreclosures

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this response payload was generated.

items.description: Supreme Court BIT real estate foreclosure opening results and period notices ordered by auction date descending.

offset.description: Zero-based pagination offset applied to the matched record slice.

partialResult.description: True only if a live upstream sub-source returned partial coverage.

returnedCount.description: Number of structured records returned in items for this page.

sealStatus.description: TAPP Sigstore Rekor cryptographic Merkle seal status of the dataset.

sha256Digest.description: Deterministic 64-character hex SHA-256 provenance digest of the returned items.

stats.description: Execution telemetry including itemCount, durationMs, and upstream breakdown.

streamId.description: Underlying B2A data stream identifier that fulfilled the query.

success.description: True when the read-only query completed without upstream or validation failure.

toolName.description: Executed MCP tool name for deterministic audit correlation.
